Du löst ein Single-Item Lot-Sizing-Problem mit Kapazitätsrestriktion über 20 Perioden. In jeder Periode kann produziert werden (mit fixen Setup-Kosten, falls produziert wird, plus variablen Produktionskosten pro Einheit), bis zur jeweiligen Kapazitätsgrenze. Nicht verkaufte Mengen werden mit Lagerkosten pro Einheit auf die Folgeperiode übertragen. Kein Anfangsbestand. Ziel: Minimiere die Gesamtkosten (Setup + Produktion + Lagerhaltung) über alle Perioden, sodass die Nachfrage jeder Periode exakt gedeckt wird.

```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Periodendaten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 17, "setup_cost": 406, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "2": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 224, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "3": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 170, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "4": {"demand": 34, "setup_cost": 330, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "5": {"demand": 31, "setup_cost": 351, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "6": {"demand": 25, "setup_cost": 143, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "7": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 475, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "8": {"demand": 43, "setup_cost": 288, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "9": {"demand": 16, "setup_cost": 344, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "10": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 264, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "11": {"demand": 23, "setup_cost": 428, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "12": {"demand": 29, "setup_cost": 423, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "13": {"demand": 49, "setup_cost": 140, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "14": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 407, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "15": {"demand": 10, "setup_cost": 261, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "16": {"demand": 13, "setup_cost": 433, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "17": {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 336, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "18": {"demand": 46, "setup_cost": 144, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "19": {"demand": 40, "setup_cost": 180, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "20": {"demand": 27, "setup_cost": 105, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2}
}

# Kapazität pro Periode
capacity = {
    "1": 19, "2": 21, "3": 32, "4": 37, "5": 28, "6": 34, "7": 42, "8": 58,
    "9": 26, "10": 46, "11": 27, "12": 42, "13": 45, "14": 32, "15": 14,
    "16": 20, "17": 30, "18": 55, "19": 39, "20": 39
}

# Modell erstellen
model = gp.Model()
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
production = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(period_data.keys(), vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[t]["setup_cost"] * setup[t] +
        period_data[t]["prod_cost"] * production[t] +
        period_data[t]["holding_cost"] * inventory[t]
        for t in period_data.keys()
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for t in period_data.keys():
    t_int = int(t)
    # Nachfrage decken
    if t_int == 1:
        model.addConstr(production[t] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[t] + inventory[str(t_int - 1)] == period_data[t]["demand"] + inventory[t])
    
    # Kapazitätsbeschränkung
    model.addConstr(production[t] <= capacity[t] * setup[t])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[t] >= 0)

# Optimierung
model.optimize()

# Ergebnis
result = {
    "production": {t: int(production[t].X) for t in period_data.keys()},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

# Ausgabe
import json
print(json.dumps(result))
```
